title: Audit SARIF artifact fallback
summary: Adds workflow-artifact and job-summary fallback output for Ruff and Semgrep SARIF scans.
reason: GitHub Code Scanning is blocked for the private repository without GitHub Code Security/GHAS, so scanner output needs to remain available from normal Actions artifacts and summaries.
behavior_before: Audit SARIF generated Ruff and Semgrep SARIF files and attempted Code Scanning upload only; private-repo Code Scanning failures could leave no usable alert surface.
behavior_after: Audit SARIF always preserves generated SARIF as workflow artifacts, writes finding counts to the job summary, and treats Code Scanning upload as best-effort.
rollback_plan: Remove the Audit SARIF artifact upload and job-summary steps, remove upload-artifact/GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY checks from check-github-audit-spine.ps1, and delete this change packet.
notes:
Publish Ruff and Semgrep SARIF as workflow artifacts and job-summary counts when Code Scanning is unavailable.
Guard the audit workflow artifact and summary fallback contract.
Code Scanning upload remains in the workflow but is best-effort via continue-on-error because private-repo Code Scanning is blocked without GitHub Code Security/GHAS.
